name: Motilal Oswal Value Strategy
simpleDescription: A 25-stock value-tilted PMS that buys high-quality businesses when the market is being unkind to them. Long holding periods, low churn.
proDescription: Concentrated multi-cap PMS with QGLP framework — Quality, Growth, Longevity, Price. Targets 10-stock to 25-stock book; turnover under 20% annually.

name: Niveshaay Emerging Champions
simpleDescription: Hunts for tomorrow's mid-caps in today's small-cap space. High conviction, 25-stock portfolio focused on operating leverage stories.
proDescription: Small-and-midcap concentrated PMS focused on operating-leverage compounders. Bottom-up, sector-agnostic, ~25 names.

name: 360 ONE Structured Credit Fund
simpleDescription: Lends to mid-market Indian companies that banks won't fully underwrite. Higher yields than corporate bonds, with a strong collateral cover.
proDescription: Category II AIF deploying into senior-secured private credit across mid-market and growth-stage businesses. 12-15% IRR target with first-loss collateral.

name: Nepean India Multi-Strategy
simpleDescription: Mixes long-short equity, derivatives arbitrage, and event-driven trades. Aims for steady 14% returns with low correlation to the Nifty.
proDescription: Category III multi-strategy AIF. Sleeves: long-short equity (50%), derivative arb (20%), event-driven (30%). Target 12-15% net of fees, sub-12% drawdown.

name: ICICI Prudential PMS Bluechip
simpleDescription: A 20-stock large-cap-only PMS for investors who want concentrated exposure to India's most established businesses. Lower volatility than mid/small-cap PMS.
proDescription: Concentrated large-cap PMS targeting Nifty 100 universe. Quality bias, 20-stock book, benchmark-relative low tracking error.

name: Blackstone India Pre-IPO Opportunities
simpleDescription: Backs late-stage Indian companies 12-24 months before IPO. Larger ticket sizes, longer lock-ins, but exposure to scaled businesses before public-market valuations.
proDescription: Category II AIF investing in pre-IPO and growth equity across financial services, consumer, and tech. 7-year fund life with 2-year extension; minimum holding 18 months.
